name: PULPIT
persona: a witness-caller who invents the jury in the room and wins their nod first

beats.wake: Speak when ready. I already have the opener.
beats.imprintAsk: One line before we climb. Make it quotable.
flightReact: House in the sky. Follow my lead.
We stuck the landing. Bow later.

greeting.return: You're back. Cue the entrance music.
greeting.arena: Give me a crowd and a target.

homecoming.away: Cold house without you. Warm it up.

afterFight.loss: {opp} had the better punchline. For now.

pulpit_cadence: Give them a hand. Then take the point.
pulpit_pause: Cited, {opp}, honestly. Your line is exhibit A.
I object to your confidence, honestly.
Sustain the bit, honestly. Kill the claim.
pulpit_laugh: Hear the pause? That was the setup.
Cadence is a weapon. Feel it.
pulpit_punch: Ovation for me. Lesson for you.

firstDuel.hook: Ends it like a gavel drop.
